name: Seller exhaustion base break
hypothesis: Buy above a completed base after unique net-seller count and sell notional both contract without loss of exit liquidity.
spec: Setup: A declining supply of active sellers may permit a rebound. Entry: Buy above a completed base after unique net-seller count and sell notional both contract without loss of exit liquidity. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the base or on renewed seller expansion. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
